content.label: Dad's big question
content.question: Good colleges are here too, why go there?

answers.title: Share your reason
answers.detail: Course, exposure or career. Say honestly what your real reason is.

answers.title: Research together
answers.detail: Look at universities, costs and options together. Make the decision together too.

answers.title: Keep both open
answers.detail: Plan for both, here and abroad. Compare, then choose.
